# Stage Overview: `r params$stage_name`

**Execution Mode:** `r if (isTRUE(params$imputed)) "Imputed Cohort Pipeline" else "Complete-Case / Raw Cohort Pipeline"`  
**Data Source:** `r params$data_path`  

```{r load_data}
if (file.exists(params$data_path)) {
  cohort <- readRDS(params$data_path)
} else {
  # Synthetic placeholder for document compilation checks
  cohort <- data.frame(
    patient_id = 1:60,
    time = rexp(60, 0.1),
    status = rbinom(60, 1, 0.7),
    biomarker_a = rnorm(60, 50, 10),
    biomarker_b = rnorm(60, 100, 15),
    group = factor(rep(c("A", "B"), 30))
  )
}
```

This report summarizes statistical findings for **`r params$stage_name`** (`r nrow(cohort)` subjects).

# Correlation & Collinearity Structure

```{r correlation_summary}
num_vars <- names(cohort)[vapply(cohort, is.numeric, logical(1))]
num_vars <- setdiff(num_vars, c("patient_id", params$time_col, params$status_col))

if (length(num_vars) >= 2) {
  pairs_tbl <- correlated_pairs_table(cohort[, num_vars, drop = FALSE], cutoff = 0.4)
  knitr::kable(pairs_tbl, caption = "Highly Correlated Feature Pairs (|r| >= 0.40)", digits = 3)
}
```

# Survival & Stratification Diagnostics

```{r survival_diagnostics, eval = !is.null(params$time_col) && params$time_col %in% names(cohort)}
plot_survival_km(
  cohort,
  time_col = params$time_col,
  status_col = params$status_col,
  group_col = params$group_col,
  title = paste("Survival Profile -", params$stage_name),
  risk_table = FALSE,
  p_value = !is.null(params$group_col)
)
```
